build_dictionary_from_files: build a vocabulary dictionary from a list of text files with configurable threshold and nwords
load_dictionary_from_file: load a pre-built fairseq dictionary from a file on disk
build_model_for_task: build a fairseq model instance from config with optional quantization support
build_generator_for_inference: build a sequence generator with beam search or sampling for inference
get_batch_iterator: get an epoch batch iterator over a dataset with configurable batching and sharding
